name: psi(x;q,a)
ant_standard_definition: sum_{n<=x,n congruent a mod q} Lambda(n), with gcd(a,q)=1 for character reconstruction
ant_to_pvg_map: Decode valuation points, restrict prime-power support, weight by log p, and push forward to residue channel a mod q.
pvg_geometric_object: Log-weighted mass of single-axis prime-power points in one residue channel.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Sum decoded log weights in the selected residue channel to recover the finite observable exactly.
kernel_or_information_loss: Forgets integer scale and factorization details beyond the selected residue channel.
claim_ceiling: Finite observable only; no PNT-AP theorem follows from encoding.

name: psi(x,chi)
ant_to_pvg_map: Decode valuation points and weight prime-power masses by the Dirichlet-character phase.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Re-sum decoded weighted masses to recover the finite character sum.
kernel_or_information_loss: Many distinct coefficient distributions share the same weighted total.

name: Character reconstruction of residue Chebyshev observable
ant_standard_definition: psi(x;q,a)=phi(q)^-1 sum_chi conjugate(chi(a)) psi(x,chi), for gcd(a,q)=1 and a complete character set modulo q.
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply finite Fourier inversion to character-weighted residue-channel masses.
pvg_geometric_object: Finite character transform of residue-channel prime-power masses.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Inverse character transform recovers every reduced residue channel exactly.
kernel_or_information_loss: No loss inside the declared finite reduced-residue data; global integer information remains outside scope.
claim_ceiling: Orthogonality reconstructs channels but supplies no asymptotic cancellation.

name: Principal character main-term channel
ant_standard_definition: The principal character channel carries the main x/phi(q) contribution after independent PNT-AP analytic input.
ant_to_pvg_map: Mark the untwisted residue-channel mass as the candidate main-term channel.

pvg_to_ant_return_map: Returns the principal-character weighted sum, not its asymptotic estimate.
kernel_or_information_loss: The analytic main-term estimate is not generated by the geometric encoding.

ant_standard_definition: psi(x;q,a) is asymptotic to x/phi(q) for fixed q and gcd(a,q)=1.

kernel_or_information_loss: No proof gain; the translation does not encode the analytic mechanism.
